tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The off-white of a fencing uniform in light, deep ink in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Surfaces laid on paper: panels, interface cards, menus.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and primary button fill, on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on paper and paper-raised (≥ 5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Divider rules and surface borders. Never for a control border.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: The steel of the blade: control borders, piste lines, decorative icons (≥ 3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The red of the touch. Fill for critical actions (concede, confirm a play), scored points, focus. Text on top of it: on-signal.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Red used as text (errors, damage, opponent's score) on paper and paper-raised.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on signal (4.9:1).

tokens.name: laiton
tokens.usage: Aged gold (brass), the noble touch. 1px rules and small ornaments only (3:1 on paper in both themes), never as a flat fill nor for text below 24px. At most one element per screen.

tokens.name: win
tokens.usage: Victory, favorable winrate, confirmed play, as text on paper.

tokens.name: foil-base
tokens.usage: Fixed background under the foil effect, identical in both themes so the sheen keeps its shine.

tokens.name: foil-cyan
tokens.usage: First stop of the foil gradient. Only inside the foil, never on its own as an interface fill.

tokens.name: foil-violet
tokens.usage: Second stop of the foil gradient. Only inside the foil.

tokens.name: foil-pink
tokens.usage: Third stop of the foil gradient. Only inside the foil.

tokens.name: foil-gold
tokens.usage: Last stop of the foil gradient. Only inside the foil.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Border and label of common cards. A cue color, never on its own: the written label always goes with it.

tokens.name: rarity-uncommon
tokens.usage: Border and label of uncommon cards. A cue color, never on its own: the written label always goes with it.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Border, label and anticipation halo of rare cards. A cue color, never on its own: the written label always goes with it.

tokens.name: rarity-epic
tokens.usage: Border, label and anticipation halo of epic cards. A cue color, never on its own: the written label always goes with it.

tokens.name: rarity-special
tokens.usage: Alt art, showcase and signed: brass, with the foil sheen. Border, halo and traced signature. A cue color, never on its own: the written label always goes with it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The engine played 10,000 games with this list.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: game phases, categories, table headers.

styles.name: data-l
styles.usage: Key number of a result (winrate, score).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Interface card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks within a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Breathing room for hero sections.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, piste lines. The default shape: the brand is sharp-edged.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, badges. Just enough not to cut.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Game cards only. The only pronounced rounding in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Game cards lying on the table. Interface surfaces have no shadow, only rules.
